reason: Keeping my resume data on my own machine is appealing, but I don't want to set up and maintain a server or figure out which job and AI APIs are worth paying for. I already have a way to save roles, so I would wait until setup and costs are clearer.
objection: Self-hosting sounds like extra maintenance, and I can't tell what the API usage might cost me.
would_change_my_mind: A clear local-only setup guide with a no-paid-API demo and a simple way to back up my data.
